findings.body: Adding `reasoning_effort` as a plain required field to a config struct in `src/config/types.rs` will break deserialization of any existing config file that does not yet include this key, unless the field carries `#[serde(default)]` or the struct has a struct-level default. Even with `#[serde(default)]`, `String` defaults to an empty string, which is not one of the documented valid values (`off`, `low`, `medium`, `high`) and may cause downstream validation failures. I cannot see the serde derives from the diff, so this depends on whether the struct derives `Deserialize` — common for config types but unconfirmed here.
findings.title: Add serde default for new required config field

value.summary: The pull request adds a `reasoning_effort: String` field with documentation to a config struct. It is likely safe to merge, but if this struct deserializes from config files via serde, the new required field may break existing configs that omit it.
